questionText: Why isn't Cat Ba Island chosen in the itineraries of the majority of travellers coming to Viet Nam?
passageText:
Read the passage and answer the following questions.

Being overshadowed by Ha Long Bay to the north, Cat Ba Island is often left out of the itineraries of the majority of travellers coming to Viet Nam. Nevertheless, Cat Ba Island is one of the most attractive destinations in Viet Nam. 

The massive island of Cat Ba is a fantastic destination for ecotourism and adventure activities in Northern Viet Nam. Cat Ba National Park, which was established on 31st March 1986, is one of the most ecologically diverse national parks in Viet Nam. The park possesses seven different ecosystems, both underwater and inland. It is home to thirty-two types of mammals, along with seventy bird species, and more than a thousand species of plants, hundreds of which can be used as medicines. 

There are several different hiking and trekking routes through rugged and forested mountains within Cat Ba National Park. These routes are also categorized according to different types of trekking, so travellers don't have to be worried if they don't have a high level of physical fitness. In addition, travellers can take a side visit to explore the exquisite Trung Trang cave or discover the traditional village of Viet Hai.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Because it is not a good destination for tourism.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Because it is too far from Ha Long Bay.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Because there is too much rain there.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Because it is overshadowed by Ha Long Bay.

explanation:
Bị vịnh Hạ Long che khuất về phía Bắc, đảo Cát Bà thường bị bỏ qua trong hành trình của đa số du khách khi đến Việt Nam.

=> Đảo Cát Bà không được lựa chọn trong hành trình của đa số du khách khi đến Việt Nam vì nó bị che khuất bởi Vịnh Hạ Long.
sourceExamName: Đề thi chính thức vào 10 môn Anh Sở Hà Nội năm 2023

questionText: Choose the best way to rearrange the following sentences in order to make a meaningful paragraph.

Many people enjoy traveling to new places. First of all, it allows them to experience different cultures and try new foods. _____

a. In addition, traveling can be a great way to relax and take a break from work.

explanation:

Nhiều người thích đi du lịch đến những nơi mới. Trước hết, điều này cho phép họ trải nghiệm nhiều nền văn hóa khác nhau và thử những món ăn mới. (b) Do đó, việc lập kế hoạch trước và tiết kiệm tiền có thể giúp bạn thực hiện được điều đó.

questionText: What is the main idea of the passage?
passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions. 

The phrase "healthy lifestyle" is a definition of how you should live if you want to get the healthiest body you can - one that both looks good and feels good. You know the obvious behaviors that describe someone who is healthy and takes care of themselves. A healthy person doesn’t smoke, eats healthy foods with plenty of fruits, vegetables and fiber and, of course, exercises regularly. A healthy person also knows how to manage stress, gets good quality sleep each night, doesn’t drink too much, doesn’t sit too much, does everything in moderation all the time. When you look at everything that could possibly make a healthy lifestyle, you can see just how hard all of those things are in our current world.

There is no such thing as a "bad" food, but there are some foods you should try not to have regularly. Fast food refers to food that can be prepared and served quickly. It is popular as the food is inexpensive, convenient, and tastes good. Because fast food is high in sodium, trans-fat, and cholesterol, it isn't something you should eat often.

The good news is that you don't have to change everything at the same time. In fact, the trick to healthy living is making small changes - taking more steps each day, adding fruit to your cereal, having an extra glass of water, or saying no to that second helping of buttery mashed potatoes. One thing you can do right now to make your lifestyle healthier is to move more.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Ways to live a healthy life

explanation:
Câu hỏi: Ý chính của bài đọc là gì?

  • Phương án 1: Cách quản lý căng thẳng
  • Phương án 2: Một số thực phẩm lành mạnh để ăn
  • Phương án 3: Lợi ích của lối sống lành mạnh
  • Phương án 4: Những cách để có một cuộc sống lành mạnh

Thông tin trả lời:

- Đoạn 1 nói về thế nào là người có lối sống lành mạnh.

- Đoạn 2 nói về một số loại thực phẩm không lành mạnh không nên ăn thường xuyên.

- Đoạn 3 đưa ra một vài lời khuyên để sống lành mạnh.

=> Nội dung chính của bài đọc là về những cách để có một cuộc sống lành mạnh.
sourceExamName: Đề thi thử Tiếng Anh vào 10 quận Thanh Xuân năm 2025

questionText: What is the main idea of the text?
passageText:
Read the text and choose the best answer.

Shopping centers become a favorite place for people in leisure time due to various reasons. One of the main factors is the convenience they offer. These centers provide easy access to numerous shops, and help customers to explore different items all in one place. Additionally, the diverse display of goods, from clothing to electronics, in well-organized shops is a definite attraction.

In most shopping centers, it is impossible to bargain. The prices of items are usually fixed and displayed with price tags. However, there are occasional sales or discounts that you can take advantage of to get a better deal on certain items. Advertisements play a significant role in informing customers about the products on sale and encouraging them to make purchases. Therefore, people often display them prominently to attract the attention of shoppers.

However, the appearance of shopping centers makes many people, especially young people, become addicted to shopping. Some individuals become shopaholics and can't stop their shopping habit excessively. They may even make a regular schedule to visit the shopping centers, sometimes leading to complaints about overspending.

choices.label: A
choices.text: The popularity of modern shopping centers

choices.label: B
choices.text: The development of shopping in physical stores

choices.label: C
choices.text: The attractions and drawbacks of shopping centers

choices.label: D
choices.text: The negative impacts of shopping centers on young people

explanation:
Nội dung chính của từng đoạn trong bài: 

- Đoạn 1, 2: Giới thiệu về các trung tâm mua sắm và những đặc điểm giúp thu hút khách hàng của chúng

- Đoạn 3: Những ảnh hưởng tiêu cực của các trung tâm mua sắm 

=> Nội dung chính của bài đọc là "Những điểm hấp dẫn và hạn chế của trung tâm mua sắm".

questionText: What is the main topic of the passage?
passageText:
Read the following passage and choose the correct answer to each of the questions.

Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world. It is also the highest trash pile in the world. About 400 people try to reach the top every year. Having many climbers means having a lot of trash.

It is very dangerous to climb Mount Everest. The air is very thin and cold. Most people carry bottles of oxygen because they can die without it. When the oxygen bottles are empty, people throw them on the ground. They don’t have the energy to take the trash away. They only have enough energy to go down the mountain safely.

Trash is a terrible problem. Since people first began to climb Mount Everest, they have left 50,000 kilos of trash on the mountain. Several groups have climbed the mountain just to pick up the trash. When people plan to climb the mountain, they should plan to take away their trash.

choices.label: A
choices.text: A problem with trash on Mount Everest

explanation:
Nội dung chính của từng đoạn trong bài: 

- Đoạn 1: Giới thiệu về đỉnh Everest và việc nhiều người leo núi để lại rác ở trên núi

- Đoạn 2: Lý do tại sao người ta lại để lại rác trên đỉnh núi Everest

- Đoạn 3: Số lượng rác có trên đỉnh Everest hiện tại và những hành động cần làm để giảm thiểu tình trạng này.

=> Chủ đề chính của bài đọc là "Vấn đề rác thải trên đỉnh Everest".
